experiment.title: Source-aware compressed projective locator
experiment.objective: Test whether a target-independent source-prefix selector can reduce projective locator queries while preserving exact support and rank.
stopping_rules: retain failed support as a scoped negative
charge every selected query and comparator
do not treat rank as individual-log descent
do not promote toy evidence to an exponent claim
invalidation_rules: invalidate if projective counters are absent
preserve rank/support failure as a negative
experiment.success_criterion: The independent verifier confirms source-only selection, projective binding, exact witness checks, and reports support/rank retention and prefix query reduction.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Any target-dependent selection, verifier mismatch, invalid witness, missing projective binding, or failure to retain exact support/rank falsifies this selector.
